notes: Needs ruling: «قال أبو بكر» (before «وهذا أصح» and before «فذكر نحوه بمعناه») is not placed as a link; the text cannot tell whether Abu Bakr transmits or comments (rule 6)
The report carries no saying: only chains and remarks on them; «بعضهم» (unnamed) and «ولم يذكر فيه عن أبي سعيد» are variant remarks, never routes (rule 4)
